offence_note: Trafficking cannabis, ecstasy, steroids into prison by corrections officer
sentence_quote: [98] With respect to trafficking in cannabis, 48 months. [99] With respect to trafficking in ecstasy, 48 months. [100] With respect to the two counts of trafficking in steroids, 30 months on each count. These sentences are to be served concurrently.
note: Global sentence 48 months concurrent; firearms prohibition and DNA order stated as part of sentence.

offence_note: Loaded prohibited firearm possession, breach of prohibition and recognizance
sentence_quote: On Count 5 of the indictment, I am sentencing you, sir, to four years' imprisonment. You have spent 354 days in actual presentence custody on this matter and you will be credited with 531 days of presentence custody at 1.5 to one, leaving a jail sentence imposed today of 929 days
note: Counts 7 and 8 six months concurrent; other counts stayed.

offence_note: Fraud and money laundering; fine in lieu of forfeiture
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted, but the appeal from sentence is dismissed.
note: Only fine in lieu of forfeiture and its payment period at issue; prison term not shown.

offence_note: Loaded handgun, ammunition, prohibited devices, careless storage, cocaine possession
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a total sentence of 38 months’ imprisonment, less credit for pre-sentence custody and time spent subject to bail conditions.
note: Credit of 22 months includes time on restrictive bail conditions.

offence_note: Sexual assault at a work party
sentence_quote: The appellant was convicted of sexual assault, contrary to s. 271(1)(b) of the Criminal Code, for which he received a sentence of nine months’ imprisonment, followed by two years of probation.
note: Appeal concerned immigration consequences; ancillary orders not shown.

offence_note: Discharging firearm at a residence, and other offences
sentence_quote: The three‑and‑a‑half‑year sentence imposed on the accused by the sentencing judge is reinstated.
note: SCC strikes mandatory minimum, reinstates trial sentence over Court of Appeal's four years; Gladue report not considered.

offence_note: Criminal negligence causing death, dangerous driving, failing to remain
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed and a 14-year driving prohibition from the date of sentence is imposed in place of the 12-year prohibition from the later date.
note: Only the driving prohibition changed, to 14 years from sentencing; prison term of 5.5 years unchanged.

offence_note: Dangerous driving and evading a police officer
sentence_quote: The judge ordered nine months in jail, a three year driving suspension and 12 months probation.
note: Appeal dismissed except psychological assessment probation condition deleted; conditional sentence refused.

offence_note: Arson causing bodily harm and arson causing property damage
sentence_quote: the ten-year two-month sentence was entirely fit.
note: Victim fine surcharge set aside; consecutive sentences upheld.
